submission_checklist: peer review model known (single vs double anonymous)
co-author details and ORCID iDs (if fewer than 20 co-authors)
third-party material cited; permissions before acceptance
ethics statement and journal ethics policy met
journal_choice_factors: indexing (Web of Science, Scopus; 'Abstracted in' on journal page)

open_access.green: accepted version archivable in subscription journals (rules on overview page, not fully read)
open_access.transformative_agreements: hub on publishingsupport; IOPP Journal Finder checks eligibility

copyright.fully_gold_oa: author grants non-exclusive licence to IOP
